verdict.rationale: Cross-team dependency tracking is a fair question for a work-management platform like monday.com, but the pack contains no first-party documentation of dependency columns, item-to-item dependency links, or cross-board launch coordination. The nearest claims, "spot risks and progress gaps" and linking GitHub pull requests to items, are adjacent features and earn no credit. A community post describes item linking as unreliable, but with no vendor claim to contradict, it cannot make this a dispute.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track cross-team dependencies to coordinate large launches
